name: round-2-no-reload-burst-merge
repeat_rule: Emit the first candidate; suppress later same-key candidates until a full 2 seconds without that key. Suppressed repeats extend the quiet-gap timer. Other sides remain independent.
pipeline: Unchanged round-2 window scheduler, then remove disabled captions and merge repeats. The original internal scheduler still limits raw candidates to two, including subsequently hidden reloads; this preserves exact replay of stored out-of-fold captions.
false_caption_rule: Unsupported unless there is a SAME-LABEL annotation with start-1 <= caption time <= max(end, start+2). This covers the full labeled span, the first 2 seconds after onset, and the original 1-second early allowance. Direction is scored separately.
targets: Enabled game labels only. Centered targets remain excluded from primary recall; report all-direction recall separately. Reload recall is N/A, not a claimed improvement.
final_comparison: Apply this same versioned postprocessor and scorer to both cached baseline and learned-model final predictions. Never compare new-policy after numbers with old-policy baseline numbers. No tests may be opened before the explicitly authorized final evaluation.
